name: Mallcom (India) Ltd
about: Established in 1983, Mallcom (India) Ltd. is an ISO certified and government-registered star trading house. The company is in the business of manufacturing Personal Protective Equipment and Industrial Safety products.
keyPoints:
Leading Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)
Mallcom is the largest integrated Indian Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) manufacturer, with 90%+ orders coming from repeat customers, and provides the widest range of head-to-toe PPE products from helmets, eyewear, ear protection, face masks, safety garments, and gloves, to shoes, etc.[1]

cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 11.1% over past five years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Earnings include an other income of Rs.26.6 Cr.
Dividend payout has been low at 4.49% of profits over last 3 years
